description: Fixture registry for measured baseline-versus-Solve-Context agent runs under benchmarks/AGENT-EVAL-PROTOCOL.md. Tier 1 fixtures are derived one-to-one from the fixed synthetic suite benchmarks/context-v0.json; the registry pins the contract category, the agents, and the repetition count for every cell of the run matrix. Changing any fixture, category, or repetition count requires a reviewed new registry revision.
